_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.en: Dropping the subject (Went to the shop yesterday)
mistake.vi: Bỏ chủ ngữ: "Went to the shop yesterday" (tiếng Hàn được lược chủ ngữ)
mistake.l1: Korean often drops the subject when it is clear.

hook.good: I went to the shop yesterday

segments.text: Don't say, went to the shop yesterday. Say, I went to the shop yesterday.
English sentences need a subject. Say who does the action.
Repeat after me. I went to the shop yesterday.
Good job! Do not forget the subject.

native.caption: 한국어에서는 주어를 생략할 수 있지만, 영어 문장에는 주어가 꼭 필요해요. “I went to the shop yesterday”라고 말하고 “Went to the shop yesterday”라고는 하지 않아요. Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보고 Lexkite 앱에서 문법을 연습해 보세요.

en.caption: In Korean you can drop the subject, but English sentences need one: “I went to the shop yesterday”, not “Went to the shop yesterday”. Repeat after Carlos and practice grammar in the Lexkite app.
